description.narrative: South Sudan: Maban, Rumbek, Aweil East. The programme strengthens capacities of local actors in education, child protection, and MHPSS, and improves the participation and resilience of children, youth, and their families.

title.narrative: South Sudan Case Study 2023: Community Participatory Budgeting Initiative in South Sudan

description.narrative: Participatory Budgeting significantly improved local leadership and community engagement in thecommunities around the education system in Maban, South Sudan. Access to education increased throughenhancement of safety measures and protection through community decisions to improve schoolconstruction, creating safe learning spaces for children. A significant change is higher level of motivationand commitment from community members. School Management Committees (SMCs) and Parent-TeacherAssociations (PTAs) prioritised school activities to enhance the physical environment and to createknowledge on the importance of education for all children.

title.narrative: # of people receiving direct assistance via humanitarian programmes, disaggregated by region/country

description.narrative: The indicator documents the number of people directly reached via humanitarian programmes. This includes people provided with tangible goods and materials, services and supported through activities designed to raise knowledge, awareness and skills. The indicator does not count people reached indirectly, such as those benefiting from enhanced capacity of institutions, or those affected by policy changes.This is a standard output indicator under the Strategic Partnership Agreement with the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. It seeks to provide a sense of scale across change contributions funded by the agreement. Narrative case studies compliment the indicator to capture change contributions.
